name: IIIT-Hyderabad Indian Driving Dataset (IDD) and variants — OPTIONAL / FUTURE
role_summary: Future extension for Indian road-scene, device and multimodal research (stereo camera + GPS + LiDAR + OBD). NOT a V1 dependency; no adapter.
version_note: Per search summaries (secondary): IDD launched 2018; >46,000 annotated images and >12,000 LiDAR frames reported; IDD Multimodal includes front stereo images at 15 fps, GPS at 15 Hz, 16-channel LiDAR and OBD; IDD-3D reported under CC BY 4.0. Which variants and licences apply to which download must be read at the source.

data_access.method: Registration/download at the INSAAN site (not automated; not planned for V1)

license.name: UNVERIFIED — described as open and free in a secondary source; IDD-3D reported CC BY 4.0

evidence.note: 'open and free' (general IDD); IDD-3D variant 'available via a CC BY 4.0 license'.
Official page could not be fetched: the authoring sandbox's network egress proxy blocks this host.

license.attribution: Per the dataset page / paper (not read).
notes: Different variants may have different terms.

restrictions: Not used in V1. Review terms per variant before any future use.

does_not_support.why: Driving-scene perception data (autonomy research), not civic-issue reports; kept as a documented future extension for device/multimodal research (§62: dashcam, sensors).

known_limitations: No adapter, mapping or evaluation task exists by design.
privacy_notes: Road scenes may contain people and number plates.
